paper.title_en: Calculation of Signal from Millicharged Particles for RED-100 and vGeN Experiments at Kalinin NPP
paper.abstract_en: Some extensions of the Standard Model of fundamental interactions and elementary particles suggest existence of millicharged particles (MCP). This kind of particles may be produced in nuclear reactors, due to interactions of gamma rays with electrons in particular. This work presents a calculation of MCP flux and energy distribution at Kalinin NPP. The expected count rate of MCP interactions with electrons of a solid-state Ge detector and a two-phase emission detector filled either with xenon or argon is evaluated.
